result.message: Good consolidation moment: your reads correctly showed P_JGDPDVVZR3 → N_UFVHPCE46R, and separately P_ESL7UEEXIV from N_UFVHPCE46R → your goal. That's real evidence for the path. The failure came from re-reading an already-read event instead of routing P_ESL7UEEXIV once you arrived at N_UFVHPCE46R. So: the route choice was sound, but the repeated read wasted a turn. Next time, act on evidence you already have rather than re-checking it.
result.rationale: Distinguishing the outcome evidence (event data confirming a valid port chain) from the actual failure cause (invalid repeated read action), so the learner doesn't conflate a good route choice with the terminal error, per training-wheels consolidation guidance.
